What We Design & Build

Complete Interior Design & In-House Fabrication

Because every space has unique dimensions, structural conditions, and material preferences, we provide custom consultations without fixed standard rate cards. Select any service below to pre-fill your enquiry.

01

Turnkey Residential Interiors

End-to-end interior architecture for apartments, villas, and independent floors—covering space planning, 3D visualization, false ceiling, lighting, wall paneling, and soft furnishings.

  • • Living, Dining & Foyer Design
  • • Acoustic & Veneer Wall Paneling
  • • Complete Electrical & False Ceiling
02

Bespoke Metal & PVD Fabrication

Precision laser-cut stainless steel (SS 304), MS structural sections, and PVD titanium-coated room dividers, floating staircases, and architectural wall accents fabricated in-house.

  • • CNC Laser-Cut PVD Gold/Bronze Screens
  • • Cantilever & Spine Metal Staircases
  • • Custom Metal Furniture & Console Frames
03

Modular Kitchens & Glass Wardrobes

Custom-built ergonomic kitchens with boiling-water-resistant ply, acrylic/PU finishes, quartz counters, and slim-profile aluminum fluted glass overhead cabinets and walk-in wardrobes.

  • • Island, Parallel & L-Shape Modular Kitchens
  • • Bronze Tinted Glass Walk-In Wardrobes
  • • Soft-Close Hardware & Sensor LED Profiles
04

Architectural Glass & Sliding Systems

Slim-frame anodized aluminum and fluted/toughened glass sliding partitions, synchronization doors, shower enclosures, and acoustic glass office cabins.

  • • Fluted, Ribbed & Tinted Toughened Glass
  • • Floor-to-Ceiling Synchronized Sliders
  • • Frameless & Slim-Profile Acoustic Partitions
05

Terrace Pergolas & Outdoor Fabrication

Weather-resistant heavy MS hollow-section structural pergolas, laminated safety glass skylights, CNC facade louvers, and outdoor deck spaces with integrated linear LED lighting.

  • • Structural Steel & Toughened Glass Pergolas
  • • Exterior Facade Cladding & Metal Louvers
  • • All-Weather Terrace Lounge Execution
06

Commercial, Retail & Office Interiors

Brand-aligned reception lobbies, parametric slatted timber baffles, acoustic wall treatments, executive cabins, and custom retail display racks fabricated to architectural drawings.

  • • Parametric Ceiling & Reception Desks
  • • Acoustic Conference & Studio Fit-Outs
  • • Custom Metal & Wood Retail Fixtures
Seamless Turnkey Journey

How We Execute Your Project

From your first WhatsApp enquiry to final installation, our design and fabrication teams handle every detail.

Step 01

Enquiry & Site Visit

Share your requirement via our enquiry form or WhatsApp (7042257477). We schedule an on-site measurement and brief discussion.

Step 02

2D Layout & 3D Design

We develop space-optimized furniture layouts, 3D visual renders, and material moodboards in harmony with your architecture.

Step 03

In-House Fabrication

Metal partitions, staircases, modular cabinetry, and glass assemblies are precision-manufactured with strict quality checks.

Step 04

Installation & Handover

Our supervised site engineers complete civil, electrical, woodwork, and metal installation on schedule for a clean handover.
